title_original: Darknet Forums Are Fragmenting as Observed Breach Activity Rises
description: Repeated takedowns have disrupted some of the cybercrime underground’s established gathering places. The communities around them have continued to reorganize. BreachForums revivals compete with clones and alternative platforms. Russian-speaking forums have struggled to replace the relationships built around XSS and RAMP. Activity moves between venues, and a platform that gains attention after one disruption may lose it after the next. Check Point Exposure Management researchers examined two years of forum activity to understand how that disruption has changed the underground. title_original: Volant Manticore: New Iranian Threat Group Expands Cyber Espionage Across Europe and the Middle East
description: Check Point Research has uncovered Volant Manticore, a previously undocumented Iran-nexus threat group that made Cyprus a primary espionage target before recently expanding its operations also to Saudi Arabia. This group’s focus provides another indication that Iranian cyber activity is becoming more geographically distributed, with targeting increasingly shaped by changing geopolitical priorities across the Middle East and Europe. That change in focus is one of the most important parts of the discovery. It shows how quickly Volant Manticore’s targeting can respond to geopolitical developments and adds to evidence that Iranian cyber interests are extending beyond their traditional focus.
